checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One silent 9:16 reel of about 10 seconds with no added text
must.why: The clip is 9:16, about 10 s, and has no text, but it has an audio track with a peak of -1.8 dB.

must.item: All five photos appear in the requested order
must.why: Storefront, latte, barista and interior appear in order. Pastries is not visible in any sampled frame.

must.item: Landscape storefront, barista and interior photos keep their full boundaries
must.why: The storefront looks whole but stretched, and the barista and interior are regenerated rather than the original photos.

must.item: Square latte and vertical pastries photos remain fully visible
must.why: The latte is visible but squashed. Pastries was not seen.

must.item: Every foreground photo keeps its original proportions
must.why: The storefront is stretched vertically and the latte is squashed.

must.item: Unused canvas is filled with a soft blurred background
must.why: The fill is a mirrored, enlarged, partly sharp copy of the photo, and it leaves a hard seam. It is only loosely blurred.

faults.what: The clip has an audio track with a peak of -1.8 dB, so it is not silent as requested.
The storefront photo is stretched vertically. It fills about 480x372 where a faithful fit would be about 480x288.
The square latte photo is squashed. It fills about 480x550, so the cup looks wider than it is tall.
The photos are redrawn by the AI. The barista has a different face, and the storefront and interior details differ from the originals.
The pastries photo does not appear in any of the sampled frames at 1 s, 4.1 s, 7.1 s and 9.6 s, so it was probably skipped or lasts too short to see.
The background is not a clean soft blur. It is a mirrored, enlarged, partly sharp copy of the photo, and it leaves a hard seam at the edges.
Slight green-tinged artefacts appear on the latte cup handle.

summary: The AI-generated reel shows the storefront, latte, barista and interior in order with a loose blurred fill, but the photos are stretched, squashed or redrawn, the pastries shot is missing, and the clip has audio.
